title: NotificationDeliveryEvidenceType
description: Strongest receipt actually established for one notification delivery attempt

NONE.description: No acceptance or delivery receipt was established

TRANSPORT_ACCEPTED.description: A transport relay accepted responsibility, such as SMTP DATA acceptance

PROVIDER_ACCEPTED.description: A push or messaging provider accepted the message

DESTINATION_ACCEPTED.description: The protocol-defined final destination accepted the message, such as a successful webhook endpoint

RECIPIENT_DELIVERED.description: A channel-specific delivery receipt confirmed recipient or device delivery
